programme.desc: Teamet tager til Telemarks største sø, Møsvatn. De skal renovere en hytte, og Halvor bruger næsten 100 liter sort maling ude og inde, men alligevel ender hytten med en blød og behagelig atmosfære.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 410
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit rejser teamet til Harstad for at renovere en hytte til Den Norske Turistforening. Det bliver et meget særligt projekt, der tager flere uger.

programme.title: Skønne ombygninger: Episode 501
programme.desc: For første gang i Skønne ombygninger rejser fyrene til udlandet, nemlig ned til de franske vinstokke. Her renoverer de et charmerende sommerhus for et norsk par, i hjertet af Provence.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Familie og venner indtager køkkenet, når deltagerne skal guide deres nærmeste gennem madlavningen. Kærlighed, kommunikation og overblik bliver altafgørende.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Deltagerne kopierer Daks signaturret til perfektion, før de skal genskabe et personligt ferieminde på tallerkenen. Smag, teknik og fortælling skal gå op i en højere enhed.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Michelin-kok Nick Curtin viser, hvordan ét græskar kan forvandles på utallige måder. Deltagerne udfordres på teknik, respekt for råvaren og kreativ tænkning.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: “En sovs skal opfostres.” Med Mark Lundgaard fra Kog Hans’ Kælder i køkkenet handler det om koncentration og perfektion, når saucerne skal løftes til stjerneniveau.

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Michelin-kok Erin Sykes tester deltagernes visuelle hukommelse og sans for detaljen. Kan de ramme præcisionen i både smag og anretning?

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Tempoet skrues op i køkkenet, når deltagerne skal levere en klassisk simreret med dybde og balance. Overblik og timing bliver afgørende under pres.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1304
programme.desc: Der er ikke mange ting tilbage på realitystjernen Vivi Bachs krop, der ikke har været forbi en kirurg , men kan Paradise-baben mon diske op med en menu med lige så meget kirurgisk præcision?

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1305
programme.desc: En forsamling af fire vidt forskellige personligheder mødes, når designeren Søren Le Schmidt skal imponere, men ikke alle ved bordet er lige diplomatiske, når de tilkendegiver deres holdninger.

programme.title: Til Middag Hos: Episode 1307

programme.title: The Hills: Lauren and Jason: Part 2
programme.desc: Da Jason, Laurens eks fra Laguna Beach, dukker op i hendes liv igen, indser Lauren, at hun måske ikke er kommet sig over ham. I sit nye job spørger Heidi om prisen er for høj.

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant
programme.desc: Som militær entusiast fra Colorado Springs, sælger Ebony sin ROTC-uniform for at købe graviditetstøj. Hun og hendes kæreste Josh havde planlagt at melde sig til luftvåbenet, men både det og deres eksamen bliver måske forpurret af en ny baby.

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 404

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 501

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode: 1
programme.desc: This episode includes: Tami Lynn, Hudson Valley UFO (Pts. 1 & 2) and Daredevil Doe & UD.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries

programme.desc: This episode includes: Dreams Come True, New Orleans Killer, Comic Relief & UD and J.D. Method & UD.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Ghosts of Bolton Sea Cadets
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team heads to Bolton to check out the alleged haunting at Sea Cadets academy.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Buried Beneath The Bowling Green
programme.desc: Buried under the location Sean investigates tonight, is the bones of the deceased and it appears that they are at unrest. Will Sean solve the mystery of who is haunting this location?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo
programme.desc: Sean investigates one of the UK's most haunted pubs, with is very own dungeon. Haunted by multiple spirits, it appears to be very active and Sean is not prepared for what happens to Paul.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: I Hear a Baby Crying
programme.desc: The team investigate the Market Hotel in Bolton. Believed to be haunted by the lost soul of a previous landlord and a guest who likes to make herself known. They make contact with spirits from the other side and witness first hand paranormal activity.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Wet And Wild Stripper Extravaganza
programme.desc: Michael cheated on his wife Alecia with a stripper who may now be pregnant. Sarah confronts a stripper named Amy who she says slept with her man. Missy is here to lay down the laws of the strip club.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Jaw Dropping Wedding
programme.desc: Jake slept with his brother Joe’s fiancé. Then, Danny claims he’s leaving his fiancé Heather for a professional escort named Chelsi. Plus more stories of wild nuptials.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I'm Leaving My Wife For a Tranny
programme.desc: John is cheating on his wife Destinee with Cici, but Cici's got some secrets too. Then, Lala drops a bombshell on her man. Plus Michael and his wife Tayliana both have secrets to reveal to each other.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I'm Karate Kicking You Out!
programme.desc: Greg tells Kim that he wants to start dating Mandy. Shannon confronts Dominic and friend Brandy for their affair. Plus, Leah wants her girlfriend Mary to choose between her or her ex Richelle!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: My Wife Moved Her Boyfriend In
programme.desc: Allen's wife Latasha moved in her boyfriend Boo and Allen's ready to put his foot down. Will Latasha cave in or will she leave Allen for Boo? Don't miss this on Jerry Springer!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Teen Moms Do Battle
programme.desc: Andrew is dating Tabitha and Courtney. Then, Donna betrayed Bethany by sleeping with her boyfriend. Plus, LaToya wants Andrew's ex, Antoinette, gone, but she isn't going anywhere!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Return of the Past Guests - Part 1
programme.desc: Josh will teach Danny a lesson about respecting women. Then, Nicole is here to confront her sister Jennifer once and for all!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Stuck In A Coffin
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a five-alarm fire, first responders discover a lifeless body. When Kenda learns that the deadly blaze was no accident, he launches a manhunt.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Eyes Wide Shut
programme.desc: A park ranger discovers the corpse of amateur boxer Corey Edge floating in a shallow creek. Kenda learns the victim had ties to the criminal underworld, and investigates a rogue’s gallery of hustlers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: River of Blood
programme.desc: Two hunters discover a blood-drenched car, its owner riddled with buckshot. Lt. Joe Kenda learns the car was reported stolen the day before, he follows its trail to a group of unlikely suspects.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: End of Days
programme.desc: The discovery of a family home littered with corpses tasks Kenda with unspooling the paranoid obsessions of a diseased mind, and forces him to confront his greatest fear.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Snitch
programme.desc: When officers respond to a shooting , they discover the body of a young man they know all to well -- police informant Jimmie Stevenson. it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine who pulled the trigger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: A retired military officer is found dead in his own backyard during a freak ice storm in San Antonio, Texas.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Lawman Ed Cantrell, known as "the fastest draw in the West", kills one of his drug agents, Michael Rosa, in an Old West-style shootout in 1978. In court, the jury heard two completely different stories.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E04.Mortgage Fraud & Charity Fraud
programme.desc: A travel agent is sentenced to four years for defrauding over 30 customers out of more than $278,000 in bogus vacation packages.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Moving to the safe suburbs of St. Louis proved deadly for a housewife, while her husband was miles away on a "daddy's weekend" with the four kids.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Stephen Klenczar – Bogus Barrister
programme.desc: Obsessed with boys toys, he posed as a barrister and claimed he worked for the British Government secret service.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: War Ensemble
programme.desc: Amongst the violence, torture and genocide of the Holocaust, stories of hope and survival also emerged after the horrors of World War II.

programme.title: Once Upon a Forest aka Il était une forêt
programme.desc: Fra skaberne af Pingvinmarchen. Skrevet og instrueret af Luc Jaquet inviterer filmen tilskueren til en aldrig før set verden af ​​naturligt undren og svimlende skønhed. For første gang vil vi være i stand til at se en regnskov vokse foran vores øjne.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Eric Clapton: Life in 12 Bars
programme.desc: 'Eric Clapton - A Life in 12 Bars' sætter Claptons rolle i moderne musik og kulturhistorie ind i den rette sammenhæng.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Central Banking Conspiracy
programme.desc: Richard speaks with several independent researchers about the efforts of international bankers to control the course of history and enslave humanity through their monopoly of the creation of money and the manipulation of the money supply.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Could vampires be real? A well-known U.S. paranormal investigator and folklorist in New York City recounts the legend and evolution of the vampire throughout history and from culture to culture.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Roswell UFO Crash
programme.desc: Richard speaks with the pre-eminent investigators of the alleged crash of a UFO near Roswell, New Mexico in 1947.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Death of Princess Diana - Tragic Car Accident or Murder Most Foul?
programme.desc: An investigation into the various conspiracy theories revolving around the tragic death of Diana, The People's Princess, in Paris in August 1997.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Secret Space Program
programme.desc: Were the Mercury, Genesis, Apollo and Space Shuttle programs mere window dressing designed for public consumption?

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Werewolves
programme.desc: The legend of the werewolf throughout history and in various cultures is explored. The Conspiracy Show travels to England and rural Wisconsin to investigate claims of actual werewolf sightings.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks

programme.title: Past Hunters: Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.desc: Der er alt at kæmpe for i Striden, hvor sejrsholdet vinder en stor fisk. I Dysten hviler presset på to fra hver strand, der skal sikre sejren og dermed undgå at stemme en kammerat hjem.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen

programme.title: Turbomodul
programme.desc: Endnu engang skal vi se og ikke mindst høre hvor skidt vor ven Karsten har det, når han besøger Lars midt i jobsamtale. Selv Fjeder skulle starte et sted, og det har han da tænkt sig fortælle om. Alt sammen og meget mere er i vente til den spændte seer!

programme.title: Turbomodul

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Det er første søndag i advent, og Ditzel er pissesur! Sidste år fik han nemlig alt for få julegaver, så i år vil han have fat i ham den røde prop, som står for uddelingen af alle gaverne.

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Ditzel er rejst helt hen til det lokale indkøbscenter, for der plejer Julemanden jo altid at hænge ud med en masse unger på skødet. Det er et oplagt sted at starte!

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Ingen held i indkøbscenteret, men nu har Ditzel totalt regnet den ud! For han er faldet over beviser på, at Julemanden skulle bo på et sted kaldet Granland med masser af grønne grantræer.

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Ditzel er desperat! Han har brugt tre dage i sin søgen efter Julemanden, men uden held. Og desperate situationer kræver jo som bekendt desperate handlinger, så derfor rejser Ditzel simpelthen tilbage i tiden til 1800-tallet.

programme.title: Ditzel og jagten på julemanden
programme.desc: Det er 25. december, og julen er overstået - men det ved Ditzel ikke, og stor er glæden da også, da han støder ind i selveste nissen Pyrus fra den der julekalender med 3D-brillerne!

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Jacob er sengeliggende. Det går dog hurtigt op for Lars, at det måske ikke står heeelt så slemt til, som Jacob selv mener. Men, Lars ved godt at puberteten er en besværlig tid, så han forbarmer sig over Jacob og tilbyder ham sin assistance.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: For at få afdækket en smule af pubertetens mysterie, og måske ændret ved Jacobs vrangforestillinger deraf, er de taget et smut forbi en ekspert på området.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Jacob er blevet kropsbevidst. Selvom han i forvejen er en ‘hunk', er der et par skridt endnu, før han når ‘stunner’, og dét har han tænkt sig at gøre noget ved. Derfor er han taget i fitnesscenter for at få styr på sin bod’.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Det er endelig lykkes Lars at overbevise Jacob om, at selvom puberteten er skrøbelig og forvirrende størrelse, er alt ved den også helt og aldeles normalt. Ja, også at onanere. Sidstnævnte viser sig at det er en sand pandoras æske.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten
programme.desc: Jacob er ved at forberede sig til klassefesten. Jacob og Lars er ikke helt enige i, hvordan man gebærder sig overfor det modsatte køn. Derfor tager de ud til en, der underviser i takt og tone.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzel vs. Puberteten

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Jacob har nået konfirmationsalderen, men han er dog ikke videre begejstret over konfirmationsforberedelserne og den svage præst. Og biblen? Bare topnoller fiktion fra øverste hylde.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Jacob er blevet Kristian ad helvedes til, for jo mere man tror på Jesus, jo flere gaver får man til sin kongdiamation! Jacob er derfor taget til epicentret af al skam, lyst og synd - Bycentret - hvor han prøver at frelse alle de rådne sjæle.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Jacob skal selvfølgelig have nyt tøj prøver samtidigt at holde hjulene i samfundet kørende ved at bruge rigtig maaaange pang'. Kviklån? Ja tak. Let's go shopping!

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Dagen er kommet, hvor Jacob Ditzel skal kongdiameres - hvis altså verdens ringeste præst har tænkt sig at give ham lov.

programme.title: Jacob Ditzels konfirmation
programme.desc: Ingen konfirmation uden fest for fulde sejl!

programme.title: Herreklubben

programme.title: Riis & Støiholm

programme.title: Hvad gjorde dig til
programme.desc: Lars har besøg af Ulrich Larsen, aka Muldvarpen. Hvordan fandt han mod til at rejse undercover til Nordkorea? Hvad lå bag beslutningen, og hvordan har det påvirket hans liv? En spændende samtale om mod og oplevelser.

programme.title: Riis & Støiholm

programme.desc: Allan og Dennis taler med Per Wind – tidligere målmand og træner i FC København, som deler gode fodboldhistorier og kærlighed til sporten og solen.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Erik og Tiff åbner op om deres venskab, deres “Mean Girls”-univers og deres Simba-sejr. Et stærkt, sjovt og ærligt afsnit om at bruge sin stemme, stå ved sig selv – og være sød i en hård verden.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Mads Dyhr deler sin vilde rejse fra TikTok til Simba-vinder, sit liv som nybagt far og sit forhold til krop, træning og mental sundhed. Forvent masser af energi, grin, shuffling – og et uundgåeligt skrig.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Jas & Mika ser tilbage på deres rolle som medskabere af Simba Prisen, deres rejse som par og creators – og hvordan det føles nu at være gæster i stedet for værter. Et ærligt afsnit fyldt med nostalgi, kærlighed og store drømme.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Håb åbner op om sit liv og personlige tanker bag kameraet, sin rolle som vært på Simba Prisens guldløber, karrieredrømme, personlige valg og sit forhold til Anna Thimgaard. Glæd dig til varme øjeblikke, grin og en intens “Gæt en by”-leg.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Et ærligt, rørende og sjovt afsnit med Tobi & Kamilla om livet som forældre, flytning, forlovelse, kostplan og YouTube-karrieren – samt vejen til deres første Simba. Tårer, grin og en “ulækker” konkurrence.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Anna Thimgaard fortæller åbent om sit gennembrud som content creator, sit privatliv og sin udvikling – både som menneske og creator. Et ærligt afsnit om drømme, usikkerheder, succes, kærlighed og hvad der venter i fremtiden.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Pelle og René sætter ord på tilblivelsen af ”Den Gode Gerning”. Hør hvordan René nærmest ved et tilfælde bliver revet med i foretagendet, og så står de med en vild opdagelse efter, de har optaget de første videoer – det er kun de ”gamle” der hjælper!!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: En af de bedste gerninger, man kan gøre, er at sige noget pænt til en fremmed. Det er vi ikke så gode til her i landet, derfor lader vi selvfølgelig en mand gøre det. Det er SÅ fedt, dejligt og tankevækkende at se folks reaktioner på de søde ord.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvordan går det, når vi har allieret os med TV-værten Anders Breinholt? – det bliver lidt noget rod, og senere, så ender vi i et kæmpe dilemma, når der pludselig er flere, der springer til for at hjælpe – og vi har kun én præmie.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Denne her gang fortæller vi blandt andet om den nok mest populære video, vi har lavet – en video med Lukas Graham, der overrasker en hjælpsom fan, 10-årige Felix. Felix er SÅ sødt og hans reaktion trækker tårer hos alle der ser videoen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi kommer omkring nogle klassiske videoer, og så prøver vi noget nyt. Vi får en bager til at give en gratis brunsviger til dem, der vælger at sætte musik på og danse i butikken – det er det sjoveste vi har lavet!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvad gør folk, hvis de får valget mellem at beholde en stor gave selv og give en lille en videre – eller omvendt!? Det ser vi på i de her videoer, hvor vi netop leger med at give dem, der hjælper, den mulighed. Det er overraskende, hvad der sker.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Din lille luder!”, sådan bliver der blandt andet sagt i en vild video, hvor vi får en skuespiller til at sige ting, som kunder rent faktisk har sagt i virkeligheden i en kundeservice i Bilka – en video, hvor vi virkelig var nervøse under optagelsen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Udenom og sågar henover – sådan foregår det, når folk skal passere det løbehjul, som vi har lagt på gaden midt i Århus. Det skaber stor forargelse skaber vores første virale hit. Se også hvordan det går, når vi gentager eksperimentet i Odense.

programme.title: De unge mødre
programme.desc: Camilla har haft store overvejelser om at starte en ny familie, men nu går det pludselig stærkt. Melissa, der er blevet forladt af sin kæreste og er gravid i femte måned, har svært ved at få økonomien til at hænge sammen, efter hun er blevet alene.

programme.title: De unge mødre
programme.desc: 18-årige Stine skal til lægen, for hun har tabt sig alt for meget, efter hun for 4 måneder siden blev mor. Gravide Melissa har svært ved at spise ordentligt efter at kæresten har forladt hende.

programme.title: De unge mødre

programme.title: De unge mødre
programme.desc: 17-årige Line skal til optagelsesprøve på X-faktor og har sin søn med. Kristinas store fritidsinteresse ødelægger hendes økonomi, og tvinger hende til at tage en svær beslutning. Og Malou Stella fejrer, at hun nu er blevet myndig.

programme.title: De unge mødre
programme.desc: Kristina får den endelige afgørelse på, hvem der er far til hendes søn på halvandet år. 17-årige Line får svar på, om hun går videre i X-faktor. Og Malou Stella er omsværmet, men kræsen med, hvem der er værdig til at være hendes kæreste.

programme.title: De unge mødre
programme.desc: Katharina kæmper for at komme videre i livet efter, at hun har overgivet sin nyfødte søn til hans far. Stine er bekymret over at skulle overlade sin datter til fremmede.

programme.title: De unge mødre
programme.desc: Camilla skal til fitnesstræning for første gang i sit liv - for hun skal tabe sig, selvom hun er gravid. Christina fra Amager har fået mere tid til familien efter hendes nystartede firma gik ned.

programme.title: De unge mødre
programme.desc: Rebezcas ægteskab er under pres efter Jacob forsvandt fra hjemmet i dagevis efter et skænderi. To måneder før Melissa skal føde, kan hun ikke klare sig selv længere og må have hjælp fra veninderne. 18-årige Stine er på date, og hun tager datteren med.

programme.title: De unge mødre
programme.desc: Rebezca er sur på sin mand Jacob, og det kan koste ham en tur i fængsel. Gravide Melissa må trodse de smerter, hun har på grund af graviditeten for at passe sine hunde.

programme.title: De unge mødre
programme.desc: Hverdagen er hård for Rebezca med en mand i fodlænke, en lille søn og lejligheden fuld af dyr. Malou Stella er droppet ud af skolen for femte gang og har stadig ikke taget sin 9. klasses eksamen.

programme.title: Kvart i Bold: Indersiden: Carlos Zeca: Jeg elsker Ståle

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Creepin'

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 502

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 503

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 504

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 505

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 602

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 604

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Three hairs, microscopic fibers, a common trash bag ripped from a roll. Seemingly small and insignificant clues become a victim's silent witness.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: I Hear a Baby Crying
programme.desc: The team investigate the Market Hotel in Bolton. Believed to be haunted by the lost soul of a previous landlord and a guest who likes to make herself known. They make contact with spirits from the other side and witness first hand paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: The Mischievous Ghost of The Kings Arms Hotel
programme.desc: Sean investigates claims that a mischievous ghost going by the name of Alice is causing havoc at The Kings Arms Hotel. This is one night at a hotel that the team will not rest.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: 14 Ghosts of The Bate Hall
programme.desc: Sean heads to Macclesfield, Cheshire to investigate a building said to be haunted by 14 ghosts and also the lost soul of a witch. With so many spirits in one of the oldest public houses in the UK, will any of the ghosts join him tonight?

programme.title: Ghost Dimensions Top 10 Scariest Moments
programme.desc: A special look into the top 10 of Ghost Dimension’s scariest moments. Venturing into the UK’s most haunted buildings, we take a look back at the scariest captures.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Haunted Grotto
programme.desc: Hidden secrets and a mischievous ghost are hiding in a haunted cave in Sefton Park. Ghost Dimension make contact with strange paranormal entities, that put on a full display of ghostly activity! Could this be the most haunted adventure yet?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Prisoner of War
programme.desc: Barrow Green H17 Anti-Aircraft Battery build to protect the Liverpool Docks and general area and a former prisoner of war camp, holds some sinister secrets and Ghost Dimension uncover paranormal activity dating back to WW2. What will be caught tonight?

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Return of the Past Guests - Part 1

programme.desc: Bill wants his wife to move back in with him and his girlfriend. Then, Courtney confronts her fiancé about his mistress. Plus, Acquanette tells Mike it's her or his rap career!

programme.desc: Watch the sparks fly as Victoria confronts the man who stole her man! Then, can cash strapped Stacy win Janelle back from Big? Will Jamie forgive Mariah for cheating on him?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Snitch
programme.desc: When officers respond to a shooting , they discover the body of a young man they know all to well -- police informant Jimmie Stevenson. it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine who pulled the trigger.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: With Friends Like This
programme.desc: A young man is found gunned down outside his home. Sgt. Joe Kenda and Det. John Anderson must determine whether the killer was a complete stranger, a barrio gang member, or a jealous lover.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Trust No One
programme.desc: When martial arts enthusiast Carl Hunt suffers a fatal knife wound to the gut, his friends and neighbors offer few viable leads. But Kenda discovers blood evidence that proves he’s being lied to.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bullet With My Name On It
programme.desc: In his first year on the force, rookie patrol officer Joe Kenda quickly learns the ropes. But when he tries to singlehandedly stop a brawling mob, he finds himself facing down gunfire.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Written in Blood
programme.desc: A community is shocked when Antoine McKenzie is brazenly shot outside an auto parts store in broad daylight. The only lead left for Lt. Joe Kenda is a final message written in the victim’s own blood.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Shoelace Killer
programme.desc: A party on the outskirts of the city turns into a nightmare for some teenagers when they discover a woman’s corpse.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: War Ensemble
programme.desc: Amongst the violence, torture and genocide of the Holocaust, stories of hope and survival also emerged after the horrors of World War II.

programme.title: Courage in Red: Clan Labs
programme.desc: Behind the closed-doors of the RCMP drug units which target the dangerous Meth and Ecstasy labs devastating Canadian neighbourhoods.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: New York City, known for its diversity and acceptance, becomes the focus for a sadistic serial killer targeting the gay community. It takes dogged determination and new technology to bring a monster's reign of terror to an end.

programme.title: Under Arrest: A Big Bite
programme.desc: Police chase a suspicious vehicle, love gone bad results in a bloody altercation and a drug dealer is taken down at gunpoint.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Boston, MA. The lazy Charles River curves through this old town of universities, banks and insurance companies. One of the oldest cities in the country, Boston has always prided itself on its sophistication and its tolerance.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Burlington, North Carolina--a town built on family, God, and Southern hospitality is shaken to its core when a local Sunday school teacher is brutally murdered.

programme.title: Eric Clapton: Life in 12 Bars

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues: Deadly Waters
